A '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]<ref name="NEC" /> took place in [[3996 BBY]]<ref name="TEA" /> during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. In the battle, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] used the [[Dark Reaper]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] hundreds of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].
